event.title: Christmas Market in the Olydorf
event.text: Glühwein, waffles and good company. Come by, bring friends, and help us set up if you like!
event.note: Helping at the stand? Remember your health certificate (Gesundheitszeugnis) if you serve drinks or make waffles.
